title: Return & Exchange Policies
subtitle: Configure category eligibility, return windows, fault rules, and restocking fees
searchPolicies: Search policies by name or category...
noPoliciesDesc: Create your first policy to control customer and store return windows.
storewidePolicyNote: This baseline policy automatically governs all retail products and customer orders unless an explicit category policy overrides it.
categoryPolicyNote: This dedicated policy overrides storewide defaults for all items categorized under this specific catalog group.
noQcRequiredDesc: Returns under this policy are evaluated with standard visual inspection.
finalSaleNotice: Items under this policy are strictly non-returnable and non-refundable (Final Sale)
finalSaleNoticeDesc: All sales are final with no return or exchange eligibility unless defective upon receipt.
receiptStrictDesc: Customer must present invoice or order number before refund.
receiptOptionalDesc: Returns allowed without physical receipt with system lookup.
packagingStrictDesc: Factory box, seals, and bundled accessories must be intact.
packagingFlexibleDesc: Open-box or repacked items accepted with standard grading.
sectionGeneralSubtitle: Define policy identification, product categorization, and storewide defaults
defaultStorewideDesc: Apply automatically to any catalog item that has no category-specific policy override
sectionFeesSubtitle: Set return windows, restocking fee percentages, and shipping fault rules
restockingDesc: Administrative deduction applied to non-fault returns for handling and inspection
customerShippingDesc: Shipping fee deducted from customer refund when item is returned for mind-change
storeShippingDesc: Reimbursed shipping covered by store when item is defective or mis-shipped
sectionRulesSubtitle: Configure eligibility, exchange rights, and required proofs
isReturnableDesc: Allow customers to request refund for products under this policy
allowExchangeDesc: Enable customers to swap for replacement size, color, or alternate product
receiptRequiredDesc: Must provide proof of purchase with valid order/invoice number
packagingRequiredDesc: Item must be returned in original manufacturer box with barcode and seals intact
